scientific_integrity: No authorship or independent verification is claimed. Finite tests supplement a separate all-length bijective proof. Only the bivariate refinement and first-appearance classification are presented as potentially new.
scientific_limitations: The exact full bivariate length-by-first-occurrence spectrum is for alternating binary prefixes only; it does not prove any global binary maximum. The univariate scalar counts and generating function are already in OEIS A238374. Equivalent previously unlocated bivariate treatments remain possible.
title: Exact length and first-appearance spectra of scattered palindromes in alternating binary words
